# Lumina

> Lumina is an AI meeting assistant for teams. It joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft
> Teams calls, records and transcribes them, and delivers a summary with decisions and
> action items.

Lumina was previously known as InboxZap, an email cleanup tool. The product and company
pivoted to meeting intelligence; InboxZap is no longer offered. Older /blog posts about
email cleanup predate the pivot and are kept for reference, each labeled accordingly.

## Product facts

- Supported platforms: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams.
- Transcription: speaker-labeled, 30+ languages.
- Integrations: Slack (action items), Notion and Confluence (recaps), CRM (transcripts).
- Pricing: Free for teams up to 5 (30-day transcript history). Pro: $12/seat/month
  (unlimited history, action-item routing, priority support). Enterprise: custom
  (SSO/SAML, data residency, custom retention).

- [Home](https://lumina.example/): product overview and FAQ.

- [Pricing](https://lumina.example/pricing): plan details.
